annotations.title: Find registered apprenticeship programs to request apprentices from

description: Registered apprenticeship programs a contractor can send a good-faith request to (26 CFR 1.45-8(f)(1)): a program whose area covers the facility and that trains the occupation. For Tennessee it reads the State Apprenticeship Agency’s live list of registered programs (program, occupation, participating employers, county) and filters by occupation and county; for other states it gives the apprenticeship.gov partner finder and the State office to contact. Occupation is matched as text, so "electric" finds Electrician programs.

counties.description: County names to keep (e.g. ["Warren", "Van Buren"]); leave out for the whole state.

occupation.description: The trade, e.g. electrician, laborer, operating engineer, solar.
